en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a canal in a historic city with stepped‑gabled houses on both sides, a pointed tower in the right foreground, and a tall belfry rising in the background. A railing lines the canal edge in the foreground. At the bottom is a caption in French identifying the view as the Quai du Rosaire and the belfry in Bruges, along with the publisher credit 'ND Phot'.
